classEngineCapabilities: PROVISIONAL PLAYTEST CONTRACT. Wisdom is the Cleric class ability. S = 1/2/3/4 at Cleric levels 1/5/11/17. M = max(1, Wisdom modifier) unless a feature explicitly substitutes another ability. Cleric technique attack = d20 + normal character proficiency bonus + Wisdom modifier. Cleric technique save DC = 8 + normal character proficiency bonus + Wisdom modifier.

Conviction is separate from Resonance Points. Base Conviction maximum is 3, automatically becoming 5 at Cleric 9; after a long rest you begin at your current maximum. A completed short rest restores 1 spent Conviction, to the maximum. A completed long rest restores all Conviction. Conviction Pool raises the maximum by 2. Conviction persists between encounters; simply declaring prayer, repeating a Rite, or performing harmless actions outside a real encounter never generates Conviction.

Only explicit features generate Conviction. Sacred Chant, Sermon of Purpose, Doctrine Shield, Dark Conviction and other printed cards are valid generators. A feature cannot generate more Conviction than its text permits, and Conviction can never exceed the current maximum. Summoned creatures, friendly creatures, trivial creatures, repeated corpse manipulation and staged out-of-combat actions cannot be used to farm Conviction.

Cleric techniques use only their printed RP and Conviction costs. All RP is paid from the Cleric's Core Systems V 2 Resonance Point pool. A Cleric technique is not automatically an ordinary spell-rank cast and does not receive Overcast, spell-slot, cost-discount or spell-proc benefits unless a feature explicitly says otherwise. Ordinary spells continue to use Core V 2 spellcasting rules.

Protected Dissonance interaction: once on each of your regular turns, when you spend at least 2 Conviction on a Rite or Invocation, reduce Dissonance by 1, minimum 0. The expenditure must actually occur; waived Conviction costs do not vent Dissonance. A single feature expenditure vents at most once even if it spends more than 2 Conviction. No Cleric card automatically adds Dissonance unless explicitly written.

One concentration effect may be maintained at a time. Starting another concentration effect immediately ends the previous one. Damage uses the current Core Systems concentration rule; for this pilot, if a division requires rounding, half damage is rounded down. Sustained Cleric effects use their printed maintenance cost and Bonus Action. A control effect that persists for multiple pulses or rounds gives the target a new save at each printed pulse or at the end of each affected turn as stated.

Round recharge counters are set after resolution and decrease once at the start of the Cleric's regular initiative turn, even if the Cleric cannot act. Extra Actions and extra turns do not create extra recharge ticks. Outside initiative, each uninterrupted 6 seconds counts as one recharge tick. Only a positive counter may be reset or shortened, and a named ability can receive at most one reset or shortening per round.

Healing cannot exceed maximum HP, does not remove Wounds, and does not restore a dead creature unless a card explicitly says it resurrects. No Cleric feature provides unlimited permanent HP or resource restoration outside encounters. Temporary HP does not stack with itself; use the higher value. Resurrection and corpse-based effects have explicit use limits and cannot generate repeatable corpses, XP, loot or Conviction.

Invocation Attunement is gained automatically at Cleric level 2. Choose exactly one Invocation Path: Radiance, Judgment, Renewal, Flame, Veil or Echoes. Only the selected path bonus becomes active. Divine Invocation uses the mode belonging to that selected path unless another feature explicitly permits a different mode. Changing Invocation Path requires a future explicit retraining rule; this draft provides none.

PROPOSED ACQUISITION FOR PLAYTEST. Cleric 1: gain the Divine Favor engine and choose 4 Base cards, at least 2 Active. Cleric 2: automatically gain Invocation Attunement and the selected Invocation Path bonus, then choose 2 additional Base cards. Cleric 3: enter Bishop and choose 2 Arch cards, at least 1 Active. Levels 4-8 each grant one eligible Base/Arch choice, respecting each card's minimum class level. Level 9 grants one eligible Arch choice plus Bishop's Mandate automatically. Level 10 choose Saint, Priest or Cultist and gain 2 Hero choices from that path. Levels 12, 14, 16 and 18 each grant one additional Hero choice; levels 11, 13, 15, 17 and 19 grant one eligible unselected Base/Arch choice. The chosen Hero Finale is automatic at Cleric 20. ASI/feat milestones remain separate and do not consume these choices.

All acquisition gates use Cleric class level, not total character level. Proficiency bonus still follows normal total-character-level rules. A multiclass character cannot use non-Cleric levels to unlock Bishop, Hero, Invocation or Finale features. Divine commands, visions and social abilities can influence actions only to the extent their exact mechanical text states; no Cleric feature can force a player character to adopt, abandon or profess a belief.

Capacity clarification: the automatic level 9 Conviction increase is a new draft completion so every Hero can pay its 5-Conviction Finale without buying Conviction Pool. Conviction Pool adds 2 at any level, yielding 5 early or 7 from 9. It never fills gained capacity immediately.

allAcquiredClassCapabilities.name: Lay on Hands
allAcquiredClassCapabilities.cost: Choose 1 or more Lay on Hands points, maximum L per Action
allAcquiredClassCapabilities.effect: Restore 1 HP per point spent, maximum class level per activation. Alternatively spend 5 points to end Poisoned or allow one immediate save against an existing disease that permits saves; cannot erase special-quest diseases, Wounds or death. This is finite pool healing, no RP conversion.

source.originalText: Lay on Hands: Healing pool equal to 5 × your Paladin level; can heal or remove conditions.

allAcquiredClassCapabilities.name: Divine Sense
allAcquiredClassCapabilities.effect: Know presence, number and direction of celestials, fiends and undead not behind total cover. Does not reveal identity, thoughts, moral alignment or ordinary hidden humanoids. At 18 reveals eligible disguised outsiders through mundane/magical disguises, still no total cover penetration.

source.originalText: Divine Sense: Detect the presence of celestial, fiendish, or undead entities within 60 feet.

allAcquiredClassCapabilities.name: Martial Proficiency
allAcquiredClassCapabilities.effect: Proficient with all simple/martial weapons, all armor and shields. Does not grant a second fighting style, extra attack, proficiency in every tool or double armor/shield bonuses.

source.originalText: Martial Proficiency: Proficiency with all armor types, shields, and weapons.

allAcquiredClassCapabilities.name: Divine Strike
allAcquiredClassCapabilities.effect: Use engine Divine Strike/Smite dice and later Oath modification. Declare after hit, then pay; normal critical dice rules. Not a spell and produces no Dissonance. Cannot trigger from reflected/copy/companion damage.

source.originalText: Divine Strike: Channel divine energy into your weapon attacks, dealing additional damage.

allAcquiredClassCapabilities.name: Protective Stance
allAcquiredClassCapabilities.effect: Gain+1 AC. Once before end, Reaction interpose for adjacent ally hit by weapon: reduce its damage by S+M and take that much unpreventable damage yourself. Cannot redirect again or create resource/damage triggers. You must remain conscious.

source.originalText: Protective Stance: Enter a defensive posture that increases your AC and allows you to intercept attacks meant for nearby allies.

allAcquiredClassCapabilities.name: Righteous Challenge
allAcquiredClassCapabilities.effect: WIS save; failure disadvantage on attacks against other creatures while it can perceive you. It may move, use nonattack actions or decline attacks; no compelled suicide, belief change or full turn loss.

source.originalText: Righteous Challenge: Mark an enemy, forcing them to focus on you or suffer penalties.

allAcquiredClassCapabilities.name: Bolstering Presence
allAcquiredClassCapabilities.rangeAndTarget: Up to 3 allies 15 ft who can perceive you
allAcquiredClassCapabilities.effect: Each gains+2 on its next save against Charmed or Frightened and M temporary HP. Use strongest save bonus from same class; does not end existing conditions automatically.

source.originalText: Bolstering Presence: Inspire nearby allies, granting them temporary bonuses to saves against fear and charm effects.

allAcquiredClassCapabilities.name: Sacred Touch
allAcquiredClassCapabilities.effect: Stabilize a living Downed creature at 0 HP without healing; damage/ordinary rules can end stability. Alternatively pay 1 RP and examine 1 minute to learn whether one curse/disease affects it, without revealing origin or cure. No resurrection or free healing.

source.originalText: Sacred Touch: Channel divine energy to stabilize a dying creature or detect the presence of curses and diseases.

allAcquiredClassCapabilities.name: Aura Scaling
allAcquiredClassCapabilities.effect: Use exact radius, target cap, secondary benefit, reactive Smite, Aura Surge and Manifestation engine rules. Only chosen Oath aura applies; inverted aura replaces it. Multiple Paladin auras of same name do not stack numeric benefits.

source.originalText:
Aura Scaling
Level 3: 10 ft radius, base aura effect active while conscious
Level 6: 15 ft radius, gains secondary benefit (e.g., DR, saves)
Level 7: 15 ft radius, gain reactive Smite or spell trigger
Level 10: 20 ft radius, aura persists for 1 round if incapacitated
Level 15: 30 ft radius, aura debuffs enemies or buffs allies
Level 17: 30 ft radius, Aura Surge (1/rest) - double aura power or trigger burst effect
Level 20: 30+ ft radius, Divine Manifestation - aura auto-activates on initiative, cannot be suppressed

allAcquiredClassCapabilities.name: Signature Power (Level 11)

allAcquiredClassCapabilities.effect: Automatically gain only your Oath's Signature, or corresponding inverted Signature if Oathbreaker. This unlock cannot be spent early as a Base/Arch selection. Rest references mean short rest unless card expressly long rest.

source.originalText:

Gain access to your Oath's Signature Power, a potent once-per-rest divine ability unique to your chosen Oath:

Mercy: Miracle Veil – Heal + Prevent death
Vengeance: Judgment Brand – Doom mark, bonus crit
Dominion: Heaven's Decree – Obey or suffer
Flame: Holy Inferno – AoE Smite purge
Ancients: Thorn Crown – Reflect status
Silence: Vow Unbroken – Bonus Smite if you stay silent
Chain: Warden's Lock – Lock enemies in zone
Grief: Final Vigil – Channel ally's power
Chains Broken: Righteous Quake – Break bindings, AoE push
Martyr King: Crown of Embers – Team-wide DR + damage redirection

allAcquiredClassCapabilities.name: Divine Resistance (Level 13)
allAcquiredClassCapabilities.effect: Choose fire, necrotic or psychic resistance. Same-type resistance does not stack. This is independent of Aura but does not automatically extend to allies.

source.originalText:
Divine Resistance (Level 13)
Choose one type of damage to gain resistance against: Fire, Necrotic, or Psychic.

allAcquiredClassCapabilities.effect: Allocate remaining points among targets, at least 1 each; restore 1 HP per point. You may instead allocate 5 points per target to end Poisoned or Frightened. source.originalText:

Once per rest, expend your entire Lay on Hands pool to create a wave of healing energy that affects all allies within your aura radius.

allAcquiredClassCapabilities.name: Divine Sense
allAcquiredClassCapabilities.effect: Divine Sense identifies celestial/fiend/undead nature despite ordinary disguise or shapeshift. Still requires clear line of effect; cannot reveal through walls or defeat artifact-specific concealment without its rule.

source.originalText:
Divine Sense: Detect Disguised Outsiders (Level 18)
Your Divine Sense now reveals outsiders (celestials, fiends, etc.) even if they are disguised or shapeshifted.

allAcquiredClassCapabilities.name: Final Oath Gift (Level 20)

allAcquiredClassCapabilities.effect: Gain only your Oath's Final Gift. Oathbreaker instead gains Black Manifestation below. Do not grant all ten gifts, restore use by switching Oaths, or combine with another Final from different class level.

Receive the ultimate blessing of your Oath, a powerful capstone ability that represents the pinnacle of your divine connection.

allAcquiredClassCapabilities.frequency: One paid Smite total per round, shared with all normal and reactive Smite uses; any redirection uses its shared allowance
allAcquiredClassCapabilities.effect: Choose radiant or necrotic when you Smite; the entire Smite packet uses that type. After damage, apply Vengeance Mark until the end of your next regular turn. allAcquiredClassCapabilities.duration: While conscious, marked and in aura
allAcquiredClassCapabilities.frequency: Choose targets at start of each turn
allAcquiredClassCapabilities.effect: Selected marked enemies take -1 on saving throws and cannot Hide from you or benefit from mundane concealment against you. This does not reveal a creature behind total cover or defeat supernatural invisibility unless another feature does so.

originalObjects.value: Aura of Judgment — marked enemies within aura suffer −1 saves and cannot hide from you

allAcquiredClassCapabilities.rangeAndTarget: One creature you can see within 60 feet
allAcquiredClassCapabilities.effect: Brand the target for 3 rounds. It counts as Vengeance-marked. originalObjects.value: Judgment Brand — doom mark on target; bonus crit damage and pursuit (1/rest)

value.spell: Sentence of Doom — smite deals max dice vs marked

value.spell: Final Verdict — marked foe at or below half HP within 30 ft saves or drops to 0 HP; on success, your next smite deals max dice and they cannot regain HP until end of next turn

background.name: Aethel City Guard Veteran

Tool Proficiencies: One type of gaming set, Vehicles (Land)
Equipment: A piece of your old uniform (e.g., a dented helmet or worn insignia), a map of Aethel's main districts, a set of common clothes, manacles, and a belt pouch containing 10 gp.

allAcquiredClassCapabilities.name: Lay on Hands
allAcquiredClassCapabilities.cost: Choose 1 or more Lay on Hands points, maximum L per Action
allAcquiredClassCapabilities.effect: Restore 1 HP per point spent, maximum class level per activation. source.originalText: Lay on Hands: Healing pool equal to 5 × your Paladin level; can heal or remove conditions.

allAcquiredClassCapabilities.name: Divine Sense
allAcquiredClassCapabilities.effect: Know presence, number and direction of celestials, fiends and undead not behind total cover. Does not reveal identity, thoughts, moral alignment or ordinary hidden humanoids. At 18 reveals eligible disguised outsiders through mundane/magical disguises, still no total cover penetration.

source.originalText: Divine Sense: Detect the presence of celestial, fiendish, or undead entities within 60 feet.

allAcquiredClassCapabilities.name: Martial Proficiency
allAcquiredClassCapabilities.effect: Proficient with all simple/martial weapons, all armor and shields. Does not grant a second fighting style, extra attack, proficiency in every tool or double armor/shield bonuses.

source.originalText: Martial Proficiency: Proficiency with all armor types, shields, and weapons.

allAcquiredClassCapabilities.name: Divine Strike
allAcquiredClassCapabilities.effect: Use engine Divine Strike/Smite dice and later Oath modification. Declare after hit, then pay; normal critical dice rules. Not a spell and produces no Dissonance. Cannot trigger from reflected/copy/companion damage.

source.originalText: Divine Strike: Channel divine energy into your weapon attacks, dealing additional damage.

allAcquiredClassCapabilities.name: Protective Stance
allAcquiredClassCapabilities.effect: Gain+1 AC. Once before end, Reaction interpose for adjacent ally hit by weapon: reduce its damage by S+M and take that much unpreventable damage yourself. Cannot redirect again or create resource/damage triggers. You must remain conscious.

source.originalText: Protective Stance: Enter a defensive posture that increases your AC and allows you to intercept attacks meant for nearby allies.

allAcquiredClassCapabilities.name: Righteous Challenge
allAcquiredClassCapabilities.effect: WIS save; failure disadvantage on attacks against other creatures while it can perceive you. It may move, use nonattack actions or decline attacks; no compelled suicide, belief change or full turn loss.

source.originalText: Righteous Challenge: Mark an enemy, forcing them to focus on you or suffer penalties.

allAcquiredClassCapabilities.name: Bolstering Presence
allAcquiredClassCapabilities.rangeAndTarget: Up to 3 allies 15 ft who can perceive you
allAcquiredClassCapabilities.effect: Each gains+2 on its next save against Charmed or Frightened and M temporary HP. Use strongest save bonus from same class; does not end existing conditions automatically.

source.originalText: Bolstering Presence: Inspire nearby allies, granting them temporary bonuses to saves against fear and charm effects.

allAcquiredClassCapabilities.name: Sacred Touch
allAcquiredClassCapabilities.effect: Stabilize a living Downed creature at 0 HP without healing; damage/ordinary rules can end stability. Alternatively pay 1 RP and examine 1 minute to learn whether one curse/disease affects it, without revealing origin or cure. No resurrection or free healing.

source.originalText: Sacred Touch: Channel divine energy to stabilize a dying creature or detect the presence of curses and diseases.

allAcquiredClassCapabilities.name: Aura Scaling
allAcquiredClassCapabilities.effect: Use exact radius, target cap, secondary benefit, reactive Smite, Aura Surge and Manifestation engine rules. Only chosen Oath aura applies; inverted aura replaces it. Multiple Paladin auras of same name do not stack numeric benefits.

source.originalText:
Aura Scaling
Level 3: 10 ft radius, base aura effect active while conscious
Level 6: 15 ft radius, gains secondary benefit (e.g., DR, saves)
Level 7: 15 ft radius, gain reactive Smite or spell trigger
Level 10: 20 ft radius, aura persists for 1 round if incapacitated
Level 15: 30 ft radius, aura debuffs enemies or buffs allies
Level 17: 30 ft radius, Aura Surge (1/rest) - double aura power or trigger burst effect
Level 20: 30+ ft radius, Divine Manifestation - aura auto-activates on initiative, cannot be suppressed

allAcquiredClassCapabilities.name: Signature Power (Level 11)
allAcquiredClassCapabilities.cost: One short-rest use plus printed cost
allAcquiredClassCapabilities.effect: Automatically gain only your Oath's Signature, or corresponding inverted Signature if Oathbreaker. This unlock cannot be spent early as a Base/Arch selection. Rest references mean short rest unless card expressly long rest.

source.originalText:
Signature Power (Level 11)
Gain access to your Oath's Signature Power, a potent once-per-rest divine ability unique to your chosen Oath:

Mercy: Miracle Veil – Heal + Prevent death
Vengeance: Judgment Brand – Doom mark, bonus crit
Dominion: Heaven's Decree – Obey or suffer
Flame: Holy Inferno – AoE Smite purge
Ancients: Thorn Crown – Reflect status
Silence: Vow Unbroken – Bonus Smite if you stay silent
Chain: Warden's Lock – Lock enemies in zone
Grief: Final Vigil – Channel ally's power
Chains Broken: Righteous Quake – Break bindings, AoE push
Martyr King: Crown of Embers – Team-wide DR + damage redirection

allAcquiredClassCapabilities.name: Divine Resistance (Level 13)
allAcquiredClassCapabilities.effect: Choose fire, necrotic or psychic resistance. Same-type resistance does not stack. This is independent of Aura but does not automatically extend to allies.

source.originalText:
Divine Resistance (Level 13)
Choose one type of damage to gain resistance against: Fire, Necrotic, or Psychic.

allAcquiredClassCapabilities.name: Lay on Hands
allAcquiredClassCapabilities.cost: All remaining Lay on Hands points; minimum 1
allAcquiredClassCapabilities.rangeAndTarget: Up to 3 living allies in aura
allAcquiredClassCapabilities.effect: Allocate remaining points among targets, at least 1 each; restore 1 HP per point. You may instead allocate 5 points per target to end Poisoned or Frightened. Spend entire pool, cannot multiply it by recipient count, raise the dead or remove Wounds. Oathbreakers instead deal allocated necrotic damage to 3 enemies, CON half, same pool cost.

source.originalText:
Lay on Hands: Full Cleansing Wave (Level 17)
Once per rest, expend your entire Lay on Hands pool to create a wave of healing energy that affects all allies within your aura radius.

allAcquiredClassCapabilities.name: Divine Sense
allAcquiredClassCapabilities.effect: Divine Sense identifies celestial/fiend/undead nature despite ordinary disguise or shapeshift. Still requires clear line of effect; cannot reveal through walls or defeat artifact-specific concealment without its rule.

source.originalText:
Divine Sense: Detect Disguised Outsiders (Level 18)
Your Divine Sense now reveals outsiders (celestials, fiends, etc.) even if they are disguised or shapeshifted.

allAcquiredClassCapabilities.name: Final Oath Gift (Level 20)
allAcquiredClassCapabilities.cost: One long-rest use plus printed cost
allAcquiredClassCapabilities.effect: Gain only your Oath's Final Gift. Oathbreaker instead gains Black Manifestation below. Do not grant all ten gifts, restore use by switching Oaths, or combine with another Final from different class level.

source.originalText:
Final Oath Gift (Level 20)
Receive the ultimate blessing of your Oath, a powerful capstone ability that represents the pinnacle of your divine connection.

allAcquiredClassCapabilities.name: Fighting Style
allAcquiredClassCapabilities.activation: Passive or Reaction, according to choice
allAcquiredClassCapabilities.effect: Choose Defense, Dueling or Protection using the exact engine profiles. Do not choose another style when entering the Oath or Hero stage.

allAcquiredClassCapabilities.name: Divine Health
allAcquiredClassCapabilities.effect: Advantage on saving throws against disease; no automatic immunity or cure of existing disease.

allAcquiredClassCapabilities.name: Extra Attack
allAcquiredClassCapabilities.effect: Make two weapon attacks instead of one. Named techniques use printed counts. This does not create two Smite triggers beyond their per-turn cap.

allAcquiredClassCapabilities.cost: Declare and spend 1 through 2 S+M points from current Lay on Hands pool, even on miss
allAcquiredClassCapabilities.duration: Damage instantaneous; charm rider until end of next turn
allAcquiredClassCapabilities.frequency: At will while Lay on Hands points remain; rider once per turn
allAcquiredClassCapabilities.effect: Make a melee divine attack using PB+Charisma. On hit deal fire damage equal to the declared points.
